observations.body: Gabriel joins David’s throne, Jacob’s house, everlasting reign, and an unending Kingdom in the announcement to Mary.
observations.label: A Kingdom with no end

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside a kingdom with no end.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Luke 1:31–35 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states gabriel joins David’s throne, Jacob’s house, everlasting reign, and an unending Kingdom in the announcement to Mary. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: A Kingdom with no end
